Hi Samir / Lisa — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying questions so we can align procurement and the commercial path: 

1) Summary of what you said on the call:
- Primary use: production inference for patient summarization (pilot -> phased rollout)
- Timeline: pilot in Sept, production by Nov if procurement clears
- Preferred buying routes: you mentioned AWS Marketplace as ideal, but Procurement may prefer a PO/Net30 flow for larger committed deals

2) Questions for Procurement (so we can route correctly):
- If AWS Marketplace is acceptable, do you need our commercial listing (SKU) + reseller info, or will you process directly through Marketplace?
- If PO is required, is Net30 acceptable or do you need a separate SLA/invoice structure for production vs sandbox?
- Any vendor paperwork (W9, vendor form) we should push first? If so, please attach or point to the internal form.

Attachments: redwood-marketplace-pricing-v1.pdf (pricing by route), SOW-draft-orion.docx (pilot scope).

Proposed next steps:
- If Marketplace works: I’ll send the Marketplace listing link and a one-page procurement summary your team can hand to Procurement.
- If PO required: we can accept PO Net30 for Dedicated commitments; we’ll send standard MSA + an invoice cadence suggestion.

Can you confirm procurement preference (Marketplace / PO / Card) and share ProcureOps contact if it’s not on this thread? I’ll follow up with whichever path you prefer and a recommended checklist for your teams.

Thanks — I’ll lock in a short follow-up after I hear back.

Best,

Hi Olga — great call, thanks for the clear recap. Procurement here prefers AWS Marketplace for speed and better visibility, but they will accept a PO (Net30) for larger committed spend. A couple specifics from ProcureOps: 

- Marketplace: Procurement asks for the exact Marketplace SKU and whether Redwood will be the direct seller or if there is a reseller arrangement. If Redwood is the seller-of-record and can provide invoices via Marketplace, that is our first choice.
- PO path: if we go PO, we need a vendor setup packet (vendor_form attached) plus standard MSA. Payments are Net30. We will need separate invoicing for production vs sandbox if billing centers differ.
- Security/compliance: they will request SOC2 evidence but that can be handled in parallel.

Attached: vendor_procurement_form.pdf (filled partially by our ops team). I’ll loop Lisa (who owns vendor setups) to confirm the internal next steps.

If you can send the Marketplace SKU and a one-page summary for our ProcureOps team today, we can try to expedite the marketplace route. Otherwise, we’ll start vendor setup for PO. Thanks — Samir
